title: MCP Discovery API — Dynamic MCP Server Discovery via Semantic Search
description: A protocol or service that allows AI agents to dynamically discover and select MCP servers at runtime via semantic search, rather than requiring all servers to be pre-configured in .mcp.json or settings.json. Agents query a discovery endpoint with intent ('I need to access calendar data') and get back a list of matching MCP servers with connection instructions.

matches: Tool Search Tool (automatic semantic tool selection)
redundancy_check.verdict: NOVEL — Tool Search Tool selects among already-loaded tools; this pattern selects which MCP servers to LOAD in the first place. Different problem scope.
redundancy_check.key_distinction: Tool Search Tool: which of the loaded tools to call. MCP Discovery: which servers to connect to before the session starts. Complementary, not redundant.

evaluation.reasoning: Novel capability that complements Tool Search Tool by operating at a different level (server selection vs tool selection). Token efficiency benefit is real: dynamic loading of only relevant MCP servers reduces the tool schema overhead even before Tool Search Tool activates. Source confidence is MEDIUM (HN secondary source). Research needed: determine whether this is a specification, prototype, or shipping service; verify whether Claude Code supports dynamic MCP injection at runtime (post-startup).
